name: Kettlebell Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two kettlebells in the front rack position against your chest and forearms with wrists straight.
Brace your abs and glutes, then press one kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is fully locked out.
As you lower the first kettlebell back toward the rack position, begin pressing the opposite kettlebell overhead in a smooth seesaw rhythm.
Continue alternating arms while keeping your rib cage down and torso stable.
tips: Avoid leaning backward or swaying side to side as the bells alternate.
Keep your elbows tucked slightly forward in the rack position before driving each press upward.
